script:
ssh -i /opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-h100 -o BatchMode=yes -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=accept-new -o UserKnownHostsFile=/opt/karpo/.ssh/rps-known-hosts ubuntu@172.31.25.147 'sudo /bin/bash -s' <<'RPS_SSH_INNER'
set -Eeuo pipefail
systemctl is-active karpo-rps-install-h100 karpo-rps-h100-v1 || true
tail -4 /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/h100-install.log
if [ -f /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/h100-install-exit.txt ]; then cat /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/h100-install-exit.txt; fi
if [ -f /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/h100-launch.log ]; then tail -8 /opt/karpo/experiments/vllm-rps100-20261120/results/setup/h100-launch.log; fi
test ! -e /run/systemd/shutdown/scheduled
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.used,utilization.gpu --format=csv

RPS_SSH_INNER
